The retired 'defaults.view' (the engine-level web floor) is GONE: the root surface is App.json's `entry.surfaces` — the ordered root plan (architecture/proposals/root-plan.md) — and view-less route rows follow the plan's boot winner. content._note: The dsx.content store (Engine/Content.swift): budget_mb caps the PURGEABLE cache tier (Caches/dsx-content); past it, least-recently-used folders are evicted at generation granularity (pinned folders and folders used this session never are). 0 disables eviction. max_blob_mb caps one streamed content blob (default 240, clamped to 1...2048); manifest and mutable single-URL control responses remain fixed at 4 MiB.
